title: Select projects under a budget (a 0-1 program)
prompt:
A firm may fund any of six projects A to F. Cost and value (both in k euro) are: A 30/40, B 25/35, C 40/55, D 35/50, E 45/70, F 50/90. The total cost may not exceed 120. Project E can only be funded if A is funded. Project F needs both B and C. C and D are mutually exclusive. At least two projects must be funded. Maximise the total value.
Name the 0-1 variables `pA`, `pB`, `pC`, `pD`, `pE`, `pF`.

Report values at the full precision the solver returns.

End your final message with one line of the form
ANSWER: {"status": "<solution status string>", "objective": <number>, "plan": {"<variable name>": <value>, ...}}
where `plan` lists every decision variable named above by exactly the name given (zeros may be left out), and `status` is "Optimal" when the solver proves optimality.
